title: Draft announcement text from the Story, check it, and approve it
description:
Part of the scheduled publishing and announcements epic. Design: docs/plans/scheduled-publishing-and-announcements.md ("Who writes the post").

Goal: each announcement's text is drafted by the LLM default (GPT-6 Luna) from the Story's title, dek and summary only, under the site's announcement voice rules held as guidelines-as-data, passes the layered fact check against the Story and the editorial rule lane, fits X's length rule, and is approved by an editor when the site requires it.

Shape: a guideline kind `announcement` (PPY-2a2a8a); draft text in S3; checks: fact check with the Story text as the only source, `papyrus editorial check` rule lane, 280 weighted characters with the link counted as X counts it; a failed check blocks posting and shows the failure; approval required or automatic per site; editors can edit then approve; with automatic approval editors can withdraw (delete) later.

Depends on: the eligibility story. Relates to PPY-2a2a8a (guidelines as data).

```gherkin
Feature: Announcement text says only what the Story says
  A post on X speaks for the publication. It must be in the site's voice and must
  not claim anything the Story does not.

  Scenario: A draft is written from the Story
    Given a 5-star Article "Can a system keep a secret from itself?"
    When it becomes eligible
    Then a draft post is written from its title, dek and summary in MoM's voice
    And it carries the Article's link

  Scenario: A draft that adds a claim is stopped
    Given a draft says "the first proof ever"
    And the Article never says so
    Then the draft is not posted
    And editors see "This claim is not in the Story: the first proof ever"

  Scenario: An editor approves on MoM
    Given MoM requires approval
    When a draft passes its checks
    Then it waits in the announcements list as "Waiting for approval"
    And when Sam edits a word and approves it, that text is posted

  Scenario: Edited text is checked again
    When Sam's edit adds a number that is not in the Story
    Then approval is refused with the failed check

  Scenario: Automatic approval can be undone
    Given a site with automatic approval
    When a post goes out and an editor chooses "Withdraw announcement"
    Then the post is deleted from X and recorded as withdrawn

  Scenario: Too long is not posted
    Given a draft longer than X allows
    Then it is not posted and editors see "Too long for X by 12 characters"
```

Open questions: none.
